description: This file declares the HttpAuth class and related enums and structures for handling HTTP authentication within the Chromium project. It includes method declarations for managing authentication challenges, headers, and responses.

classes.name: HttpAuth
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods and enums for HTTP authentication handling.

methods.name: GetChallengeHeaderName
methods.description: Returns the header name for the authentication challenge (WWW-Authenticate or Proxy-Authenticate).

methods.name: GetAuthorizationHeaderName
methods.description: Returns the header name for the credentials (Authorization or Proxy-Authorization).

methods.name: GetAuthTargetString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the Target enum for logging.

methods.name: SchemeToString
methods.description: Converts an authentication scheme enum to its string representation.

methods.name: StringToScheme
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the corresponding Scheme enum.

methods.name: AuthorizationResultToString
methods.description: Converts an AuthorizationResult enum to its string representation.

methods.name: NetLogAuthorizationResultParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary for logging authorization results.

methods.name: ChooseBestChallenge
methods.description: Selects the best supported authentication challenge from response headers.

methods.name: HandleChallengeResponse
methods.description: Processes a 401/407 response to handle authentication challenges.
